candidates.title: Synthetic synthesis topic 1
candidates.question: Which bounded judgment changes after comparable evidence is separated?

nearest_reviews.prior_synthesis: The nearest review combines the conditions.
nearest_reviews.comparison_result: The candidate separates conditions that change the conclusion.

synthesis_delta.changed_judgment: The conclusion is conditional rather than universal.
synthesis_delta.synthesis_operation: Compare studies by condition and endpoint.
synthesis_delta.boundaries: Applies only to the defined population and endpoints.
synthesis_delta.negating_evidence: A prior review already performs the same comparison with the same conclusion.

evidence_plan.P0: Pilot the extraction and comparison on representative studies.

limitations.text: Synthetic test only, not research evidence.
